# INTERIOR DECOR DIMAPUR

INTERIOR DECOR DIMAPUR is a full-service interior design, ceiling, wall panel, and architectural finishing company based in Dimapur, Nagaland. We specialize in designing, supplying, and installing modern interior solutions for residential, commercial, retail, office, hospitality, and institutional projects across Nagaland and near by location in Assam.

## Business Summary

INTERIOR DECOR DIMAPUR is a full-service interior design and interior execution company headquartered in Dimapur, Nagaland, India. The company provides complete design, material supply, installation, and turnkey interior solutions for residential homes, apartments, offices, retail stores, restaurants, hotels, educational institutions, and commercial buildings.

Core expertise includes interior design, false ceilings, gypsum ceilings, PVC ceiling systems, PVC wall panels, WPC wall panels, POP decorative ceilings, modular kitchens, customised furniture, aluminium windows, aluminium railings, steel railings, ceiling grid systems, and complete renovation projects.

The company serves customers throughout Nagaland, including Dimapur, Chümoukedima, Kohima, Mokokchung, Wokha, Mon, Tuensang, Phek, Longleng, Niuland, Kiphire, Shamator, Meluri, and nearby regions of Assam such as Lahorijan, Bokajan, Golaghat, Jorhat, and Karbi Anglong.
